_comment: A track is one positioning of your resume: headline + summary + exactly five skill lines. Pick the track whose emphasis matches the JD; add a new track only when no existing one covers it. Copy this file to config/tracks.json and replace the content with your own.

fullstack.headline: Full-Stack Product Engineer | React / Node.js
fullstack.summary: Full-stack product engineer with N years building and operating customer-facing products. Replace this with two to three sentences: your scope, your stack, one concrete proof point, and your location / work-authorization line.
skills: React, Next.js, component architecture, responsive UI
Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, data modeling
Automated testing, CI, observability, code review
Vercel, Git, cloud deployment, API integrations

frontend.headline: Frontend Engineer | React / TypeScript
frontend.summary: Frontend-focused engineer with N years shipping user-facing products. Replace this with two to three sentences emphasizing UI craft, accessibility, and product sense, plus your location / work-authorization line.
skills: React, Next.js, state management, design systems
Git, Figma handoff, analytics, feature flags
